lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: KEEP THEM AWAY! THEY'RE SMASHING KEYBOARDS WITH NO STORY STRUCTURE!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Tushar, calm down. They're just infinite monkeys generating content.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: I HATE MONKEYS! They violate the rule of thirds and disrespect cinema!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, I threw twenty grand at them, but they only take bananas. Tragic.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Step aside. I'm calling the shots now. Let's frame this rescue.

lines.text: Tushar joined the party! Press 3 to swap him in and freeze time!

lines.text: Rolling sound, rolling camera... and ACTION!
